root_idea.summary: The root centers on passing out from, emerging from, or causing something to emerge from a place, state, or source; a second established branch denotes contrast or mixture of two colors.
root_idea.development: The egress sense extends to departure, expulsion, production, extraction, outlets, and expenditure or revenue as something that goes out. A separate color branch denotes black-and-white or otherwise contrasting distribution, with related applications to patchy land, animals, and years.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Independent Form X verb with extraction meaning.
Independent noun denoting a way or outlet.

Independent noun meaning payment or expenditure.

senses.definition: to go, come, pass, or emerge out or forth; to issue, proceed, depart, or leave
senses.usage_conditions: Used both for movement from a physical place and for emergence from a state or condition. The subject may be a person, object, natural phenomenon, or thing that comes forth.

senses.definition: to cause someone or something to come, go, or emerge out or forth; to bring forth, produce, or bring out
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use. It includes bringing something into appearance or existence, as well as leading or taking something out; passive forms mean to be brought forth or brought out.

senses.definition: to drive, expel, eject, or dislodge someone or something from a place
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive removal construction, often involving expulsion from a home, land, community, or other location; passive forms mean to be driven or expelled out.

senses.definition: to extract or bring forth something from a source, container, or concealment
senses.usage_conditions: The action involves obtaining or eliciting something that is contained, hidden, or embedded; Quranic uses include bringing out an object, treasure, or material from its source.

senses.definition: bringing or causing something to emerge, appear, or be brought forth
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun of Form IV, used for the bringing forth of people, things, or created forms.
The same verbal noun in a removal construction, especially eviction or forced expulsion from a place.

senses.definition: a way, place, or means of exit; a way out
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, it denotes an available outlet or means of release from a difficulty.

senses.definition: brought out, removed, or driven out
senses.usage_conditions: Passive-participial use of Form IV, including persons who are brought out or driven from a place.

senses.definition: an exit or occasion of going forth
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression at 17:80, the form is understood as a noun of place or time, denoting a favorable exit or departure rather than merely a passive participant.

senses.definition: one who brings forth, brings out, or causes to emerge
senses.usage_conditions: Active participle of Form IV; the agent may be divine or human, and the object may be a person, thing, or natural product.
Active participle of Form I, used predicatively for one who or something that comes out or is able to come out.

senses.definition: a recompense, reward, or payment offered in return for something
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, it denotes a demanded recompense or payment, contrasted with a better provision from God.
A noun for property or money that goes out, including a payment offered for a service or undertaking.

senses.definition: going, coming, or passing out or forth; departure or coming forth
senses.usage_conditions: Verbal noun of Form I, used for ordinary departure as well as eschatological coming forth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to pass out of, escape from, or become free of an affair, condition, religion, debt, or disease
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended intransitive use for leaving or becoming quit of a state or obligation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to pay or settle a debt
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal construction with a debt as the object of release or settlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to rebel against an authority or depart from an order
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a ruler, command, or authority in an extended oppositional construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become foul or obscene in speech
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic extended use concerning a person's language.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become conspicuous or distinguished in knowledge or a craft
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended use for becoming prominent in a field of learning or skilled work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the first rising, spreading, or appearance of clouds; the emergence of rain from them; clearing after cloud
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A weather vocabulary branch describing clouds or the sky as they appear, extend, or clear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a she-camel formed in the likeness of a male camel
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of bodily formation, not a general meaning of ordinary خروج.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to explain, resolve, interpret, or render a saying
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of giving an interpretation or showing how a statement is to be understood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to educate, discipline, or train a person, horse, or camel
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative educational or training use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to make something varied, partly marked, or uneven by leaving portions distinct or untouched
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes variegating colors, writing while leaving spaces, making work of different kinds, and grazing only part of a pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a finger-guessing game in which players put forth fingers and identify the number shown
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional game played by two or more participants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to contribute equally with others to the expenses of a journey or expedition
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal financial construction involving shared costs or provisions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to contract with a slave to pay a fixed periodic amount while allowing the slave to work freely
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal manumission-related arrangement involving an agreed import or payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to be resolved, explained, or interpreted in a particular way
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a saying or proposition and its interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become educated, disciplined, or trained in accomplishments, science, or a craft
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A resultative educational use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to play the finger-guessing game together
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal use corresponding to the game called مُخَارَجَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to contribute equal shares of expenses, food, or drink
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal sharing for a journey, expedition, or common provision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to settle mutual claims to shared property by dividing or exchanging its components
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of partners or co-heirs who separate their claims by taking different assets, money, or debts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become two-colored, especially black and white
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to an animal or other object whose coloring becomes visibly mixed or contrasted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to till land and bring it into productive condition
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural extension of bringing forth productivity from land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to ask or petition someone to go or come out
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative-request construction distinct from extracting an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a saddlebag or double receptacle attached to a saddle
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for a paired or sometimes single traveling bag.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the quality of having two contrasting colors, especially white and black
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of variegated or parti-colored appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a single going out, coming out, or outing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A singular instance of the action of going out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a person who frequently goes out and in
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive noun for habitual movement between inside and outside.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a clever, ingenious, or artful person skilled in managing affairs
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended idiomatic description that may carry either resourceful or cunning connotations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a tax, tribute, land-tax, poll-tax, or revenue from land or property
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes an imposed yearly payment and revenue derived from land, a slave, or other property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the taste or yield of fruit
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension comparing fruit's product to the revenue of land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a pustule, boil, abscess, or purulent swelling on the body or an animal
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical swelling or ulcerous eruption, including veterinary uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an animal that goes ahead or outstrips others, especially a racehorse; also a she-camel that keeps apart or leads in pace
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to animals distinguished by forward movement, speed, or separation from the herd; it can also describe a long-necked horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a traditional game of Arab youths involving calling out or eliciting what is held in the hand
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional game, related in description to finger-guessing games.

other_classical_meanings.definition: subject to a land tax
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of countries or lands liable for خَرَاج.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one educated, disciplined, or trained by a particular teacher
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial designation for a graduate or trained person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: external, outside, or extrinsic; what is objective or external to the mind
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal or adjectival extension from being outside, including the contrast between external reality and mental conception.

other_classical_meanings.definition: external architectural projections, arches, vaults, niches, or ornamental forms
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized architectural plural use contrasted with inner decoration or inscriptions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a mare, female slave, or she-ass
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional collective expression for specified female members of property or livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: his generosity, intelligence, or sound management became apparent
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom for a person's abilities or good qualities emerging after immaturity or poor conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: one who stands out or excels beyond his fellows without inherited distinction; also a swift or outstanding horse
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An older evaluative use for unusual excellence, courage, generosity, or speed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a rebel or heretic; a member of the Kharijite sects
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later religious and political designation for one who separates from an authority, community, or accepted doctrine.

other_classical_meanings.definition: external, objective, or pertaining to what is outside
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective for external reality or matters outside the mind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a recognized kind of palm tree
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: two-colored, especially black and white or ash-colored
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to rams, ostriches, goats, horses, mountains, garments, and other things with contrasting coloring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a garment made white and red by blood staining
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application of contrasting colors to a garment or scene.

other_classical_meanings.definition: land with vegetation or rainfall in some places but not others
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes uneven or patchy fertility and growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a year partly fertile and partly sterile
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A year divided between abundant herbage or fruitfulness and barren conditions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a privy or the anus
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical or sanitary use of an outlet term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a time of going out or departure
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal use of the place-or-time noun distinct from the Quranic way-out sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a person's manner of entering into and withdrawing from affairs; good conduct or way of acting
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic paired expression about competent and praiseworthy management of situations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to pay one's land-tax or poll-tax
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive legal or fiscal use meaning to discharge an imposed خَرَاج.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to exclude something from the scope of a definition, rule, or category
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical or logical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to exclude someone from participation in an affair
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended transitive use with a person excluded from an undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to vent or bring out what is held in one's breast or mind
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic psychological use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to hunt ostriches described as أَخْرَج
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized hunting expression based on the bird's coloring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to marry a woman of mixed black and white complexion whose parents differ in complexion
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional lexical expression describing a mixed-complexion marriage partner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: for grazing animals to eat part of a pasture and leave part uneaten
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended use for selective or incomplete grazing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a day on which people go forth
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A poetic expression describing a day marked by departure or communal going out.

cautions: The QAC group مُخْرَج is morphologically supplied as a passive participle, while the Quranic expression at 17:80 also has lexical evidence for a place-or-time noun meaning an exit. Both readings are retained without treating the historical Lane citation notation as a modern verse location.
The color-related branches of خرج are lexically distinct from the egress branch and are kept in broader Classical Arabic meanings rather than assigned to ordinary Quranic egress senses.
